correctness.rationale: The full image of an idempotent is its fixed-point set, and every proper connected image is an arc. Complementary edges encode a unique lazy walk of length n-ell within that fixed arc. This yields exact polynomial coefficients, independently confirmed by exhaustive composition enumeration for n=3..9. The looped tridiagonal matrix spectral expansion has explicitly normalized eigenvectors, a positive leading endpoint coefficient of order \(\ell^{-3}\), a controlled spectral gap on \(\ell\) of order \(n^{1/3}\), and global norm bounds excluding other scales. Strict convexity of \(t\log3+\pi^2/(3t^2)\) proves the \(n^{1/3}\) saddle and concentration. Finite checks do not substitute for the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: All idempotent image-rank coefficients and the typical rank are natural non-extremal semigroup invariants. The full exact polynomial gives more information than total monoid cardinality or maximal rank, and the \(n^{1/3}\) concentration law exposes a nontrivial competition between an entropy loss proportional to the number of fixed arc edges and spectral confinement proportional to \(n/\ell^2\). It applies uniformly to infinitely many cycle lengths and is not merely a textbook coefficient restatement.
